invention.ref: Yuki Ueyama conceives curling pyrethrum incense into a spiral to sustain overnight smoldering for 7–8 hours
invention.ref_zh: 上山ゆき（上山英一郎之妻）构想将除虫菊线香盘成螺旋状，实现长达七至八小时的整夜持续阴燃

patent.ref: Eiichiro Ueyama files Japanese patent application for the spiral mosquito coil
patent.ref_zh: 上山英一郎在日本递交涡卷形蚊香专利申请

mass_production.ref: Commercial sales and factory production of spiral mosquito coils begin under the Kincho brand
mass_production.ref_zh: 金鸟（大日本除虫菊）在日本正式量产销售涡卷型蚊香

popularization.ref: Automated punch-press manufacturing allows mass export and universal household use across tropical regions
popularization.ref_zh: 全自动冲压成型技术问世，双盘蚊香成为全球亚热带与热带地区家庭夏夜驱蚊必备品

summary_zh: 1895 年日本上山夫妇将除虫菊线香创制为螺旋盘香，实现长达七八小时的夜间持续阴燃驱蚊；1902 年金鸟正式上市，成为风靡全球的经典夏季防蚊用品。
summary_en: Invented in 1895 when Yuki Ueyama wound pyrethrum incense into a spiral to burn overnight, the mosquito coil was launched commercially by Kincho in 1902, becoming an enduring global summer staple.

image.alt_en: A burning spiral mosquito coil smoldering with a thin plume of smoke
